Disney After Hours Returns for 2024 at Walt Disney World

/ Walt Disney World News / By Rikki Niblett

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:48
Instaread

Exciting news! Disney After Hours will be returning to the Walt Disney World Resort beginning in January 2024! And best of all, three different theme parks will offer these exclusive, separate ticketed events. During these events at Disney’s Hollywood Studios, the Magic Kingdom and EPCOT, Guests will be able to experience three hours – after normal park hours – to ride your favorite attractions, see beloved characters and enjoy unlimited, complimentary snacks! These snacks include ice cream novelties, popcorn and select beverages at a variety of locations throughout the park

 

Disney’s Hollywood Studios

These special nights will take place at Disney’s Hollywood Studios from January 10 through April 10, 2024. The park will be open from 9:30 p.m. to 12:30 a.m. Guests will be able enjoy attractions in Toy Story Land, join the resistance with Chewbacca in Star Wars: Galaxy’s Edge and climb aboard Mickey & Minnie’s Runaway Railway, among other favorites.

Magic Kingdom

At the Magic Kingdom, Guests will be able to enjoy more than 20 attractions and experiences including TRON Lightcycle / Run, which will offer a standby queue for the first time ever. The After Hours Events will take place from January 11 through April 8, 2024. In addition, Guests will be able to experience the nighttime fireworks spectacular, “Enchantment” which will return exclusively to Disney After Hours events. This means that on event nights, those who arrive early will be able to catch not only “Enchantment, but also, “Happily Ever After”.

EPCOT

Guests will be able to enjoy favorite attractions. These will include Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, Test Track, Soarin’ and Remy’s Ratatouille Adventure. Events at EPCOT will take place on select nights starting February 2 through April 4, 2024.

Additional Info

Guests who attend these Disney After Hours events will be able to enter the parks as early as 7:00 p.m.

Those Guests who are staying at a Walt Disney World Resort hotels, Walt Disney World Swan and Dolphin Hotels, and Shades of Green during the party time frames can purchase tickets starting November 7, 2023, by calling 407-W-Disney. Event tickets can be purchased online by all guests starting Nov. 14.

Disney After Hours ticket prices range from $155 to $175 (plus tax) for Magic Kingdom and Disney’s Hollywood Studios. EPCOT After Hours ticket pricing ranges from $149 to $159 (plus tax). Specially priced tickets are available for Annual Passholders and Disney Vacation Club members.
